paragraphs: R' Yehudah, son of Rabban Yochanan ben Zakkai.
Mentioned in Niddah 15a and likewise in Tosefta Niddah, chapter 3.[^1][^2]

notes.text: טו., gives Niddah 15a under the period convention, without independent named-edition verification.

פ״ג explicitly gives Tosefta chapter 3; there is understood as Niddah from the connected notice, without modern renumbering. Yehudah’s title remains R', while his father’s full Rabban remains distinct.
